title: Exam-stress toolkit
examples: What is the difference between physical and emotional stress?
Can deep breathing really help when I feel anxious?
Are there any good activities to do when I feel overwhelmed?

explain.say: Today we are learning about tools for managing stress.
First we will look at controlled breathing exercises.
A simple example is box breathing for calm.
Next we will learn about effective time planning.

draw.text: Planning: Prioritise tasks, break them down

explain.say: A good planning example is using a timetable.
Finally we look at changing your perspective.

faq.q: How long should I practice deep breathing for stress?
faq.a: You should practice for a few minutes when you feel stressed. You can also practice it daily to build the habit. Other ways to ask: How long is enough deep breathing? Should I breathe deeply every day?
asks: How long should I practice deep breathing for stress?
How long is enough deep breathing?
Should I breathe deeply every day?

faq.q: Does planning only work for schoolwork stress?
faq.a: No, planning can help with everything stressful. You can plan your chores or your free time too. Other ways to ask: Can I plan my life? Does planning only help with school?
asks: Does planning only work for schoolwork stress?
Does planning only help with school?

faq.q: What does it mean to change your perspective?
faq.a: It means choosing to look at a situation differently. Instead of seeing a problem, you see a chance to improve. Other ways to ask: How do I change my thinking? What is a new perspective?
asks: What does it mean to change your perspective?
How do I change my thinking?

faq.q: Are these tools only for big stressful moments?
faq.a: No, these are for everyday stress too. Practicing them when you feel okay makes them easier when you need them. Other ways to ask: Should I wait until I am stressed to use these? Are these only for emergencies?
asks: Are these tools only for big stressful moments?
Should I wait until I am stressed to use these?

faq.q: If I forget to plan, does that make me more stressed?
faq.a: Yes, forgetting to plan can increase stress levels. Writing things down helps your brain feel in control. Other ways to ask: What if I get overwhelmed? Is planning always necessary?
asks: If I forget to plan, does that make me more stressed?

facts: Deep breathing activates the body's relaxation response.
Breaking large tasks into smaller steps makes them feel less overwhelming.
Perspective involves changing your thoughts about an event.
Regular practice of coping skills builds resilience over time.
